payload.text: Each run is /bin/zsh -ilc of the run line, with the login shell's PATH and MENUZ_HOME/bin first on it, cwd the item's, else the file's, else HOME, stdin /dev/null, and MENUZ_HOME, MENUZ_LABEL, MENUZ_RUN_ID and (under each) MENUZ_ITEM exported; runs are concurrent, each with its own id, detached from the app (their own session, stdout and stderr on the log file directly, not through the app); Quit leaves runs in flight running and logs each as left running with its id (D9).
